title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Rider: Restore Cushion Days by Payment Frequency
content:
For the restore payment of PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering), the cushion days follow the number of payments the enrollment received in the one-month window, as its PrePay ledger shows them.

| Payments to the enrollment in the one-month window | Cushion days |
|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | 6 |
| 2 or 3 | 4 |
| 4 or more | unchanged by the payment count |

**Clause.** Where the enrollment received at most one payment in the one-month window, the cushion days are 6; where it received two or three payments in that window, the cushion days are 4; with four or more payments the payment count leaves the cushion days unchanged. Any increase or reduction of the cushion days is applied to the cushion days set here.

A window of a stated number of months takes the records dated after the same day of the month that many months before the current date, through the current date.

Notes (hypothetical counts): an enrollment with no payment in the window and one with a single payment both take 6 cushion days; a third payment in the window still gives 4; a fourth leaves the cushion days unchanged by this rule.
